source_licence_note: Official OGC, GEOS and GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply.

official_sources.title: GDAL Geometry Validity
official_sources.finding: GDAL warns that invalid geometries can produce incorrect spatial-algorithm results; validity follows OGR Simple Features rules, uses GEOS, and individual validity does not detect inter-feature gaps or overlaps.
official_sources.limitation: Validity alone does not prove parcel identity, exact boundary lineage or raster-cell membership.

official_sources.title: gdal vector check-geometry
official_sources.finding: The command checks Polygon/MultiPolygon validity and LineString simplicity against OGC Simple Features rules and reports invalidity descriptions and error locations; GEOS performs the checks.
official_sources.limitation: A reported valid geometry can still have semantic/source errors outside geometric validity.

official_sources.title: gdal vector make-valid
official_sources.finding: Make-valid runs OGRGeometry::MakeValid and normally removes lower-dimensional sub-geometries; repair can therefore alter geometry structure and must be treated as a derived transformation with before/after evidence.
official_sources.limitation: Repair is not proof that the derived geometry matches the legal or authoritative parcel boundary.

official_sources.title: gdal vector rasterize
official_sources.finding: Default polygon rasterization differs from ALL_TOUCHED; with ALL_TOUCHED the order of touching input features can affect edge pixels, so feature ordering must be deterministic and serialized.
official_sources.limitation: Rasterization semantics must be matched to the project membership policy rather than chosen for convenience.

official_sources.title: gdal_rasterize
official_sources.finding: GDAL rasterize supports on-the-fly vector reprojection to the raster CRS and target-aligned pixel output controls; source selection, transform and output grid therefore belong in the replay ledger.
official_sources.limitation: On-the-fly transformation cannot substitute for independently proven CRS and transformation provenance.

official_sources.title: GDAL rasterization algorithm API
official_sources.finding: The rasterization API documents ALL_TOUCHED as selecting all touched polygon pixels rather than only center-contained pixels and notes behavior is unspecified when a polygon only touches the pixel center.
official_sources.limitation: Center-touch boundary cases require an explicit project tie policy rather than relying on unspecified behavior.

official_sources.title: OGC Simple Feature Access Part 1 Common Architecture
official_sources.finding: OGC Simple Feature Access defines standard geometry classes and associates each geometry with a spatial reference system, providing the normative model used by GDAL/GEOS validity checks.
official_sources.limitation: The standard defines geometry semantics but does not identify the target parcel or target raster grid.

official_sources.title: OGC Simple Features polygon validity rules
official_sources.finding: OGC polygon assertions require topologically closed polygons, non-crossing rings, no cut lines/spikes/punctures, and connected polygon interiors; invalid shapes cannot be silently treated as canonical parcel surfaces.
official_sources.limitation: This older published SFS text is used for explicit polygon validity assertions; current implementation behavior is still verified against GEOS/GDAL.

official_sources.title: GEOS IsValidOp
official_sources.finding: GEOS validity follows OGC SFS defaults; self-touching rings that form holes are invalid by default, and geometry validity must be explicitly tested instead of inferred from successful file parsing.
official_sources.limitation: GEOS validity is two-dimensional and does not establish source authenticity or parcel ownership semantics.

official_sources.title: GEOS MakeValid
official_sources.finding: GEOS MakeValid attempts to preserve input vertices but may return lower-dimensional geometries, collections or MultiPolygons after self-intersection repair; repaired type/count must be validated before rasterization.
official_sources.limitation: Vertex preservation does not guarantee legal-boundary equivalence or unchanged area/topology.

official_sources.title: GEOS CoverageValidator
official_sources.finding: A valid polygonal coverage requires disjoint interiors and exactly matching shared boundary segments; the validator can expose mismatched edges and optionally narrow gaps.
official_sources.limitation: A target parcel can be individually valid while the surrounding parcel coverage is still inconsistent.

official_sources.title: GEOS CoverageGapFinder
official_sources.finding: CoverageGapFinder identifies narrow enclosed gaps in an already-valid polygonal coverage and is more targeted than generic gap-width validation for detecting slivers between adjacent parcels.
official_sources.limitation: Gap detection thresholds are project policy and must not silently mutate the authoritative boundary.
